clue.text: In hotel cat's bothersome, flipping hindrance

indicators.note: flipping turns the run found in those words so it reads backwards
the answer sits inside the run of words hotel cat's bothersome, spanning their letters

explanation.surface: A hotel's cat is being a nuisance, getting in the way of guests.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' signals letters hidden in 'hotel cat's bothersome' (ELCATSBO); 'flipping' reverses them.
explanation.definitionFit: An obstacle is a barrier or impediment, a straightforward synonym of hindrance.

clue.text: Suffering, those to pay for form of therapy

indicators.note: suffering suggests being knocked about, so the letters of those to pay are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone in pain has to pay for a course of treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: Osteopathy treats the body by manipulating bones and muscles, a recognised kind of therapy.

clue.text: Notice that's around cathedral

definitions.meaning: to notice something is to spot or perceive it
a bishop's diocese, centred on the cathedral, is his seat or territory

explanation.surface: Spotting what surrounds a cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: To see is to notice; a see is the diocese surrounding a bishop's cathedral.

clue.text: Fruit: after short period of showers it should have firm centre

indicators.note: after places the abbreviated month before what follows
short means the month's name is cut down to its abbreviation

parts.note: April is the month proverbially of showers

indicators.note: should have says IT holds another piece within it, as its centre

parts.note: taken as written
CO is the usual abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: After a brief spell of rain, a piece of fruit ought to be firm in the middle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts APRIL to APR; 'centre' confirms that CO goes into the middle of IT, giving ICOT.
explanation.definitionFit: An apricot is a soft orange stone fruit.

clue.text: Very influential member went before certain sages

definitions.meaning: a prominent, guiding figure in a group
the star of Bethlehem shone ahead of the Magi, guiding the wise men

explanation.surface: An important person walked ahead of some wise men.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is cryptic: the star that led the three wise men was literally a guiding lamp in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A prominent person who guides others is idiomatically called this; the star guiding the Magi literally was one.

clue.text: Bet there will a problem for sheep going on street!

parts.note: a ked is the sheep tick, a parasite that troubles sheep

explanation.surface: A wager that trouble awaits sheep wandering onto the road.
explanation.walkthrough: KED is the sheep tick, a less familiar word.
explanation.definitionFit: Staked means wagered, the past tense of bet.

clue.text: Grab time to set up international agreement on arms

indicators.note: in a down entry up means the words are read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: to nab is to grab
taken as written

explanation.surface: Seize the moment to establish a treaty limiting weapons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the whole string NAB+T+SET, giving TESTBAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A test ban is a treaty forbidding nuclear weapons testing, an international arms agreement.

clue.text: Vegetables — any been cooked to be eaten by children?

indicators.note: eaten by means swallowed inside the word for children

parts.note: kids are children

indicators.note: cooked means the letters of any been are mixed up

explanation.surface: Are any beans that have been cooked going to be eaten by the youngsters?
explanation.walkthrough: The beans in the surface already echo the definition. 'cooked' turns ANY BEEN into NEYBEAN, and 'to be eaten by' places that inside the youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: Kidney beans are a kind of pulse eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Mark's hasty journey

definitions.meaning: a punctuation stroke used in writing

explanation.surface: A mark's rushed trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A dash is a punctuation mark, and also a quick sprint somewhere.

clue.text: Hearing of short Bangkok holiday, one produces a winner

indicators.note: hearing of means how the phrase sounds when spoken

parts.note: a short holiday is a break, and Bangkok is in Thailand, so a Thai break

explanation.surface: Hearing about a brief trip to Thailand, someone triumphs.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis a deciding game played at six-all settles the set, producing its winner.

clue.text: When fish appear, not everyone hears them

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
ides is a freshwater fish, also spelt ide

explanation.surface: When fish turn up, few people notice.
explanation.walkthrough: An IDE is a European freshwater fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Stage remarks spoken to the audience are supposedly unheard by the other characters.

clue.text: Tedious man, libertine in need of reform

indicators.note: in need of reform says the letters of man and libertine are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A dull fellow, a rake who ought to mend his ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Something interminable seems endless and so becomes tedious.

clue.text: Noble Jacobite may become offensive

indicators.note: may become signals the letters of Noble Jacobite turn into something else

explanation.surface: A Jacobite aristocrat might turn obnoxious.
explanation.definitionFit: Objectionable means unpleasant or giving offence, a synonym of offensive.

clue.text: Daughter wanting happiness thus concealed misery

parts.note: elation is great happiness
so means thus

explanation.surface: A daughter who longs for joy keeps her sadness hidden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' is only a link here, not a sign of something missing; 'concealed' tucks the word for thus inside the joy word, giving ESOLATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Desolation is profound misery or wretchedness.

clue.text: Allow a thousand into passage

indicators.note: into means the numeral goes inside the passage

parts.note: an adit is a horizontal passage into a mine
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Let a thousand people through the corridor.
explanation.walkthrough: An ADIT is a mine entrance passage.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit someone is to allow them in, or to concede something.

clue.text: Film actor captivates director, as may be gathered

parts.note: Clark Gable, the Hollywood star
David Lean, the British film director

explanation.surface: A movie star charms a filmmaker, as you might infer.
explanation.definitionFit: To glean is to gather leftover crops or information, so what is gleanable can be collected.

clue.text: Having captured woman, the man's getting married — that's Greek culture

indicators.note: having captured means the possessive word holds the woman inside it

parts.note: his is the possessive meaning the man's
Ellen is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A man who has won a woman gets wed in the Greek way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' is just a link; 'Having captured' wraps the possessive around the woman's name, giving HELLENIS before the marriage abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Hellenism is the culture and ideals of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Country making fuss when English dog is brought across

indicators.note: brought across means the dog is stretched over and around the fuss

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
ado means fuss

explanation.surface: A nation kicks up a row when a British dog is imported.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecuador is a country in South America.

clue.text: Jolly good, next to alpha

in the NATO phonetic alphabet the code word for B follows the one for A

explanation.surface: Great, right beside the leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravo is a cry of applause, and the NATO code word for B comes after Alpha.

clue.text: Make wider way into Scottish mountain

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis
a road is a way

explanation.surface: Widen a route into a Highland peak.
explanation.definitionFit: To broaden is to widen or make broader.

explanation.walkthrough: SOUTHEND-ON-SEA is a seaside resort in Essex, east of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Southend-on-Sea is a resort on the Thames estuary in Essex, England.

clue.text: Boy who'd be green if upset

clue.text: Disease male's given a female

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for male
